facts.subject: Asgard imports
facts.statement: Asgard imports almost everything it consumes, from food and medicines to machinery and household goods.

source_ref.text_snippet: Asgard exports shipping and re-export services and imports almost everything it consumes, from food and medicines to machinery and household goods.

facts.subject: Asgard Port
facts.statement: The main port is Asgard Port, a hub with container, general cargo and passenger berths.

source_ref.text_snippet: The main port is Asgard Port, a hub with container, general cargo and passenger berths.

facts.subject: Longship Lines and Shield Insurance
facts.statement: The best-known firms are Longship Lines, a container carrier, and Shield Insurance, a marine insurer.

source_ref.text_snippet: The best-known firms are Longship Lines, a container carrier, and Shield Insurance, a marine insurer.

facts.subject: Ferry links
facts.statement: Ferry links connect the capital to smaller islands.

source_ref.text_snippet: Ferry links connect the capital to smaller islands.

facts.subject: Coastal road
facts.statement: A coastal road runs west towards the Ymir road.

source_ref.text_snippet: A coastal road runs west towards the Ymir road.

facts.subject: Asgard Port operations
facts.statement: The port operates throughout the year, with extra staff during the summer months.

source_ref.text_snippet: The port operates throughout the year, with extra staff during the summer months.
